first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, making simplification the most directly aligned intervention. The archived evidence suggests shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve early activation, but the experiment should remain guarded because early activation may not translate into durable qualified revenue. I would avoid promotional pricing because prior gains materially harmed 30-day retention.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding simplification experiment this week for simple-workspace and SMB accounts only, excluding complex-workspace accounts because shortened onboarding increased their 60-day churn by 9%. Track completion, activation, qualified revenue, and 30-/60-day retention as guardrails. The SMB signup evidence supports durable value, while the onboarding evidence is beneficial but segment-dependent; therefore a guarded test is preferable to broad rollout.
